description: Surrogate primary key, generated as an identity column. Internal, not stable across releases.

domain: type-dependent prefix: 'C-<n>' regular, 'CR-<n>' return, 'CP-<n>' pickup, e.g. 'C-42'
description: Customer identifier, unique within the instance. Referenced by raw_data.travel_matrices.start_location_id and .end_location_id, which address all location tables through one shared per-instance namespace. NOTE: the prefix encodes customer_type -- matching on id LIKE 'C-%' silently misses every return ('CR-') and pickup ('CP-') customer.

Planar x coordinate. The scale is instance-set specific and carries NO dataset-wide unit -- it is NOT meters, it differs between publications, and values may be negative. The column has no unit comment in the database for exactly this reason. NOT a geographic coordinate and not georeferenced. Never derive a distance from coordinates; use raw_data.travel_matrices.
Planar y coordinate in the same frame as x_coordinate. Same caveats apply.
Elevation above the frame's reference level. NULL for batches with flat topography; relevant for energy and emission computations on sloped terrain.
Access-restricted zone (for example a low-emission zone) containing this customer. NULL means unrestricted. Where set, a truck may be barred from the location while a robot is not.

Kind of request. Determines which demand columns carry meaning: a regular delivery populates parcel_demand with parcel_origin_id = 'DP'; a pickup request carries a pickup location id in parcel_origin_id; a return request is collected from the customer. Also determines the id prefix (C-, CR-, CP-). Open set: further values may appear in later releases.

domain: positive integer, higher means more urgent
description: Service priority of the customer. NULL for batches with homogeneous customer priorities, i.e. where priority is not a distinguishing factor of the experimental design.
Number of parcels requested by this customer. NULL where the batch does not model parcel counts.
Total weight of the customer's parcels. NULL for batches in which weight is not modeled -- do not coalesce to 0, since a load-dependent emission model would then treat the vehicle as empty.

Vehicle class eligible to serve this customer. 'Optional' means either vehicle may serve it. IMPORTANT: the unconstrained case is encoded as the literal string 'Optional', NOT as NULL -- code that tests for NULL to detect an unconstrained customer may classify every customer as constrained.

Earliest permitted service start, relative to the start of the planning horizon (t = 0, corresponding to 08:00). NOT a time of day. NULL means the batch models no customer time windows -- do not coalesce to 0, which would force service at the horizon start.

Latest permitted service start (the deadline), relative to the start of the planning horizon. Derived from the direct depot-to-customer travel time times a multiplier drawn from metadata.instance_batches.deadline_multiplicator where time_windows_customers = 'Depot Dependent'. NULL means no time window applies.
Instance this customer belongs to. ON DELETE CASCADE.

domain: location id: 'DP' for the truck depot, a pickup location id 'P-<n>', or a return-customer id 'CR-<n>'
description: Location at which this customer's parcel originates. 'DP' for standard deliveries out of the depot; a pickup location id for pickup-and-delivery requests; a return-customer id for return requests. NULL where the batch does not model parcel origins.
